title: Memorandum of V. I. Holin, suspected Soviet agent

page_data.en:
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. E. REGISTRY
No. S. B. D. 3115.
Date 15. 3. 32.

March 14, 1932

Memorandum on the movements of V.I.Holin, suspected Soviet Agent.

This individual left for Harbin via Dairen on March 11,
1932 by the s.s. " Dairen Maru".

He arrived in Shanghai from Moscow on January 18, 1932 in
company with V.A.Morison, who has come here on a certain mission on
behalf of the People's Commissariat for Foreign Trade.

While in Shanghai he resided at No 10 Hankow Road.

A. Pokofiev
D. S.

Officer i/c Special Branch.
Information
SBR
Jelephs
14.3.32.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
& S. D. REGISTRY
S. B. D. 3115
19. 1. 32.
January 19, 1932

M E M O R A N D U M

on movements of V.I.Holin, suspected Soviet agent.

Arrived from Moscow via Dairen on January 18, 1932 by
the s.s. Dairen Maru:-

Vassily Ivanovitch
HOLIN

Soviet citizen, 29 years of age, merchant.
Holds Soviet passport No 201830 issued at
Moscow on July 2, 1931.
Travelled in company with V.A.Morison, who
has come here on a certain mission on be-
half of the People's Commissariat for Fo-
reign Trade.
Efforts are being made to locate his ad-
dress.

G. Prokofiev
D.S.

Officer i/c Special Branch .
Information
SB. 19/1
